notes: Secured drawing sets (permissions only, no password) export again, and the sample drawing reopens instead of adding a copy. Counts CSV cells that start with =, +, - or @ are kept as text in Excel. Drawings with the same name get (2), (3); Compare shows each print's date and "…" while a sheet is still being compared. Search & redact no longer stacks boxes, the Count tool says to make a count first, Picture as JPG is only offered for photo sheets, a blank sheet no longer says it looks like a scan, and long notes, names and file names are kept in bounds.
